summary: A Paddington injectables clinic with a shop and press mentions is a strength, but empty sections and leaked developer text appear to cost you bookings.

findings.problem: The carousel appears to show numbered items 1 to 7 with empty links, and the Latest News heading appears to be followed by treatment and product content, not news.
findings.cost: Empty blocks on the homepage make a premium clinic look unfinished.

findings.problem: The page appears to show leaked text such as 'Use tab to navigate through the menu items.' and a pain scale line with no rating shown.
findings.cost: Developer text and blank ratings undermine trust before booking.
findings.fix: Clean copy and a real pain scale.

findings.problem: Only one testimonial appears with no star rating, twelve In the Press logos appear to have no article links, and no practitioner bio or registration appears.
findings.cost: Thin proof and no named practitioners give new clients little reason to trust.
findings.fix: Reviews with ratings, linked press and named practitioners.

findings.problem: The Shop link appears to go to shop.app in one place and facebysm.com/shop in others, the brand appears as Face + Body by SM and Face by SM, and two numbers appear with no address or hours.
findings.cost: Mixed links, names and numbers cost bookings from clients who cannot tell what is right.
findings.fix: One shop link, one brand name, address and hours.

redesign: Filled homepage blocks and real news.
Reviews, linked press and named practitioners.
One brand name, address, hours and booking flow.
